An unspecified buyer accepts proof before releasing an unspecified physical-world payment

- supports [D1, observation] Founder seeks trapped recurring physical-world money streams (`doctrine` bytes 23-144)
- supports [H1, allegation] Historical essay says dependence on external APIs precludes autonomy (`historical` bytes 0-153)

Current agent rule favors existing mechanisms when they close the effect — "Do not recommend building new substrate when an existing real mechanism closes the effect more cheaply or reliably."

- engine risk level: Ultra Low

- do_nothing (against, low): skipping this preserves founder attention for a stronger signal; the cost of waiting is one cycle of learning, not the market
